title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Stored XSS via SQL field labels in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 -…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1. The vulnerability arises because labels and values of SQL field options are returned unescaped by the reload task and inserted into the page as HTML. This allows an attacker to inject malicious scripts if user-supplied data is read by the statement.
